slimNotes: Controlled WorkWise snapshot of PPT Master v4.3.0. Core routing, references, workflows, all 64 top-level Python scripts and their modules, editable SVG/PPTX conversion, preset shapes, confirmation UI, chart templates, brand presets, deck presets, and lightweight SVG examples are retained. Large icon and AI-comparison image libraries, user projects, generated exports, backups, and private PPTX files are excluded. requirements.txt and the prompt-audit manifest are WorkWise-maintained overlays; no Pandoc dependency is installed, and optional Shape-Boolean packages (skia-pathops/uharfbuzz) are not bundled into the frozen sidecar. autoUpdate is disabled; a future upgrade requires a new audited snapshot.
